issue.title: Deep web research on Codeweb user pain
issue.description:
The user has now explicitly authorized execution: "ok. go ahead." Start the saved research plan; this supersedes its planning-only start boundary. The objective is the complete deep web research pass and independent holistic synthesis, not merely a dispatch receipt. Preserve all original acceptance criteria.

# Prepared Product Lead objective

Title: Deep web research on Codeweb user pain

User intent: Preserve the existing six-lens Codeweb audit, perform another substantial swarm research pass using public web user evidence about the problems around native Claude Code/Codex use, cross-file change confidence, ease of use, trust, and paid value; then synthesize a holistic picture. The user requested this plan before dispatch. This document is the prepared execution scope, not a record that agents have begun.

Read `reports/user-pain-research-plan-2026-09-27/README.md`, `AGENT-BRIEFS.md`, `EVIDENCE-SCHEMA.json`, and `AUDIT-BASELINE.json` in `$LOCAL_HOME/Repositories/codeweb`. Preserve the audit and screenshots with unchanged hashes. Query live Paperclip tasks and agents before creating a research parent to avoid duplicate work. Preserve active website COD-54/COD-55 and historical user gates/candidates.

Own decomposition into at most six bounded child assignments under TERMINAL-CONTRACT, using existing roles, one concurrent run per role, with available capacity and native continuation/review. Do not create agents or services. Confirm actual worker search/fetch/citation ability in the first lane before scaling. Produce public-source secondary user research; do not invent interviews or treat anecdotes as prevalence or proven Codeweb demand.

Target 150–200 fully read source pages/threads and 80–120 deduplicated useful firsthand evidence records, with honest coverage limits rather than filler. Prioritize the last six months; use older sources for persistence/history and resolve stale issues. Collect successful workflows and contrary evidence as well as complaints. Separate host/model problems from mechanisms Codeweb could address; challenge the change-brief/receipt hypothesis.

Save the requested corpus, six lane briefs, source/query maps, pain map, contradictions, audit overlay, opportunity decisions, independent review, and completion receipt under `reports/user-pain-research-2026-09-27/`. Each important claim must be supported by opened source content, dates, provenance, and an evidence ID. Independent review verifies all high-priority claims and at least 20% of the other records, and checks original audit hashes. Preserve original completion criteria through corrections.

Completion requires a supported synthesis selecting potential segments, recurring jobs, native integration requirements, adoption gaps, and charter-compatible paid opportunities, plus concrete experiments and explicit remaining unknowns. Source volume and successful task statuses alone do not satisfy the objective. Report actual runtime/access limitations and interventions.

Scope is read-only public research and local artifacts. No outreach, purchases, code changes, charter changes, merge, release, deployment, or publication. The lead owns sourcing; do not ask the founder to supply contacts or run research logistics.


Live pre-dispatch readback: no existing user-pain research objective; COD-55 remains running under COD-54. Use idle capacity for research and queue Technical Lead work behind that delivery without interrupting it. Original audit plus all four screenshot SHA-256 values matched the saved manifest. Root ordinary exec launcher returned EMFILE (too many open files); the existing Paperclip CLI works from a Node execution context. This is a root launch transport workaround, not a research-worker capability proof. Record it as an operator intervention if relevant. Do not ask the founder to route children or gather sources. Return source-supported completion through native review and durable artifacts.
